حييتن (form I)
# حَيِيتُنَّ (ḥayītunna) /ħa.jiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of حَيَّ (ḥayya) and حَيِيَ (ḥayiya)
# حُيِيتُنَّ (ḥuyītunna) /ħu.jiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of حَيَّ (ḥayya)
